---
params:
  author: "Benjamin Black"
  picture: "assets/cv_new.png"
title: '`r sprintf("%s - Curriculum Vitæ", params[["author"]])`'
author: '`r params[["author"]]`'
output:
  pagedown::html_resume:
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
    css: "cv.css"
knit: pagedown::chrome_print
---

```{r}
#| include: false

# Load config
cv_config <- yaml::read_yaml("config.yaml")

# ---- Visual theme selection (Ben Black brand) -------------------------------
# Priority: CV_THEME env var > config.yaml `theme:` > "warm".
# Each theme is a stylesheet in themes/<name>.css that overrides the --cv-*
# tokens in cv.css; it is injected as a <style> block below so it can be picked
# at render time without touching the YAML header.
cv_theme <- Sys.getenv("CV_THEME", unset = "")
if (cv_theme == "") {
  cv_theme <- if (!is.null(cv_config$theme)) cv_config$theme else "warm"
}
cv_theme <- tolower(trimws(cv_theme))
valid_themes <- c("warm", "forest", "subtle")
if (!cv_theme %in% valid_themes) {
  warning(sprintf("Unknown CV theme '%s'; falling back to 'subtle'.", cv_theme))
  cv_theme <- "subtle"
}

# Icon colours: FontAwesome icons are rendered as inline SVG with a baked-in
# fill, so CSS can't recolour them -- they must be set here per theme.
# `sidebar` = contact icons (forest sidebar is dark, so they go light);
# `main`    = link icons next to publications/talks/workshops (always on cream).
theme_icons <- list(
  warm   = list(sidebar = "#36513C", main = "#36513C"),
  forest = list(sidebar = "#DAC6A0", main = "#36513C"),
  subtle = list(sidebar = "#2B2620", main = "#36513C")
)
sidebar_icon_colour <- theme_icons[[cv_theme]]$sidebar
main_icon_colour    <- theme_icons[[cv_theme]]$main

# Set knitr options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  results = "asis",
  eval = TRUE,
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE, # Don't include messages in output (but they show in console)
  error = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE # Don't include warnings in output (but they show in console)
)

# Load functions for each section
invisible(sapply(
  X = list.files(
    path = file.path("R"),
    pattern = "\\.R$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  FUN = source
))
```

# Aside

```{r}
#| results: asis
# Inject the selected theme stylesheet. It loads after cv.css (which holds the
# structure + "warm" defaults), so its --cv-* token overrides win the cascade.
theme_css_path <- file.path("themes", paste0(cv_theme, ".css"))
if (file.exists(theme_css_path)) {
  cat(
    "<style id=\"cv-theme\" data-theme=\"", cv_theme, "\">\n",
    paste(readLines(theme_css_path, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"),
    "\n</style>\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| out.extra: 'style="width: 180px;" id="picture"'
knitr::include_graphics(params[["picture"]])
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Display data source information (messages only show in console, not in output)
message("🚀 CV Rendering Started")
message(
  "📡 Data Source: Remote GitHub repository - ",
  cv_config$cv_data_repo,
  " (branch: ",
  cv_config$cv_data_branch,
  ")"
)
message("📄 Fallback: Local files in data/sections/ (if GitHub unavailable)")
message(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""))
```
